roles.title: Product Manager, Trust and Safety
roles.location: Chicago, IL, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA

bullets: Set a compelling product vision and strategy for a significant area of Chime, connecting member needs, market opportunities, and company priorities into a clear path forward.
Lead a product organization of approximately 10-15 people, creating the structure, leadership, and operating environment for teams to do their best work.
Identify and develop new opportunities to expand Chime’s impact, using deep member understanding, data, experimentation, and market insight to determine where we should place our…
Own a broad portfolio of product initiatives and make thoughtful investment and prioritization decisions across near-term opportunities and longer-term strategic bets.
Lead through experienced product leaders, developing senior talent, strengthening the leadership bench, and creating clarity and accountability across multiple teams.

roles.title: Product Manager, App Experience and Platform
roles.location: New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA

bullets: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Chime’s Home experience, app-wide capabilities, and design system.
Shape Home into a personalized financial command center that helps members understand what has changed, what needs their attention, and what they should do next.
Partner with product teams to determine how balances, activity, insights, products, and recommended actions come together in a clear and useful experience.
Partner closely with Design and Engineering to evolve shared navigation, information architecture, components, patterns, tooling, and infrastructure.
Identify opportunities to simplify fragmented member journeys and create scalable solutions that improve consistency and product-development speed.
